newsitem.title: USA: Zebra Technologies Q1 net up on margin gain.
newsitem.headline: Zebra Technologies Q1 net up on margin gain.

text.p: Zebra Technologies Corp said Tuesday higher margins and investment income helped earnings in the first quarter ended March 29 reach record levels.

The company said net income totaled $11.2 million, or $0.46 a share, compared to $5.2 million, or $0.22, a year ago. Zebra said 1996 results were adversely affected by the acquisition of process technology.
Zebra said investment income rose to $1.1 million from $858,000 in the same period last year.
Sales in the period were $42.4 million, up from $38.4 million in 1996, Zebra said.
Zebra makes thermal transfer label printers used in bar code applications and related software.
Its shares closed off 1/4 Tuesday at 23.
